neighbours.label: the comma/'and' closing a dry-ingredient list in a baking recipe (flour, baking soda, and salt)
fire: In a large bowl, sift the flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt.
Stir together the oats, flour, baking powder and salt until combined.
Whisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a bowl.
Sift the cake flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and a pinch of salt.
Combine the whole wheat flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Mix the almond flour, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the flour, nutmeg, baking powder and salt.
Blend the rye flour, caraway seeds, baking soda, and salt together.
quiet: In a large bowl, beat the butter, eggs, milk, and vanilla.
Stir together the yogurt, honey, lemon juice and zest until combined.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, and garlic in a bowl.
Chop the onions, carrots, celery, and a clove of garlic.
Combine the cream, melted chocolate, coffee, and rum.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger, and sesame oil in a medium bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the eggs, cream, sugar and lemon.
Toss the tomatoes, cucumbers, olives, and feta together.
